messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2025-4321 — service=inference-service.prod.eu-west — symptom=p99 latency > 2000ms for 5m. Auto-page to rotation: alex (oncall).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page INC-2025-4321 created and routed to on-call. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2025-4321

alex (oncall): ack'd. I'm on it — starting triage. Anyone seeing dashboards?

maya (sre): seeing a sharp p99 spike in eu-west around 12:03 UTC, p95 also up but less extreme. Baseline p99 ~450ms -> ~2.3s. Dashboards: https://metrics.redwood/inference/eu-west?range=10m

jamal (infra): infrastructure side: autoscaler shows scale events at 12:02 but pods stayed at 0->2 attempts failed due to node provisioning timeouts. GPU nodes in eu-west are at 95% mem/capped. Node create errors: quota_limit_exceeded in cloud logs.

alex (oncall): customer impact? which routes/customers are hit?

tessa (product): looks like a concentrated set of traffic from 3 big customers on dedicated stacks in eu-west. Error rate minor (0.6% 5xx), but latency for sync generation is user-visible on some dashboards / slack reports. CS pinged a contact for one customer (noisy).

maya (sre): quick trace sampling shows a lot of long sequences (avg tokens/request increased x3) for the last 8 minutes — KV cache miss rate spiked. Candidate root cause: sudden burst of long prompts causing KV cache thrash + warmup/coldsidecar behavior. Sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c (redact).

alex (oncall): can we reduce tail by fallback routing to compatible lower-latency model / different region?

jamal (infra): we can enable region-fallback policy for eu-west -> us-west for 25% of requests to relieve the hot nodes. I'll prepare the route config. Also requesting quota bump to let autoscaler provision 3 more nodes.

alex (oncall): do it. jamal, apply 25% fallback and share the command output.

jamal (infra): running: 
```
redwoodctl route update --from inference.prod.eu-west --to inference.prod.us-west --percent 25 --reason "mitigate p99 spike"
```
Command output: route updated, traffic shift in progress (25%).

maya (sre): after 30s of shift, p99 improved from 2.3s -> ~1.1s. p95 back to ~300-400ms. KV cache miss rate dropped ~40%. Still watching.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: INC-2025-4321 acknowledged by alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): good. jamal, are autoscaler create errors still happening?

jamal (infra): quota request submitted to cloud. For immediate relief increased pod-level concurrency limits on the sidecar to reduce churn: 
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/sidecar PROXY_MAX_CONCURRENCY=64
```
Applied. Observed a small drop in coldstart churn.

maya (sre): running a targeted warmup for KV caches on the eu-west pool: `curl https://internal-warmup/eu-west/warm?pool=inference` to prefill common prefixes. Doing in waves.

alex (oncall): CS notified? We should tell the 3 affected customers we're aware and mitigating. tessa?

tessa (product): CS notified first contact with short note: "We're investigating elevated latency in EU; mitigation in progress, routing some traffic to US while we stabilize. Will follow up." I'll escalate if any customer asks for rapid mitigation.

maya (sre): 5m after routing + warmup + concurrency bump: p99 now ~850ms and trending down. Error rate normal. Looks stable but not back to baseline yet.

jamal (infra): autoscaler quota got approved — new nodes provisioning, expected online in ~4m. Once nodes join we'll ramp route back to normal.

alex (oncall): plan: keep 25% fallback for 10m after node join, monitor p99/p95. If stable, revert routing. Opening a short incident note and will hand off to next oncall for follow-up RCA.

incident-bot: Note added to INC-2025-4321: "25% traffic routed to us-west; autoscaler quota increased; sidecar concurrency bumped; KV warmup executed."

tessa (product): CS: follow-up message queued. Will include ETA: ~10-15m for full stabilization.

alex (oncall): ok folks — I'm going to hand this to maya for post-incident follow-up/RCA and jamal for infra action items. I'll remain reachable for 15m then hand off to next rotation. Handoff checklist: 1) confirm nodes healthy in eu-west, 2) rollback route if stable, 3) ensure CS updates sent.

maya (sre): acknowledged — I'll run the initial RCA: check token length histograms, KV eviction rates, sidecar memory growth over last 24h. Will draft postmortem.

jamal (infra): acknowledged for infra follow-ups: quota playbook to prevent future provision failures, autoscaler tuning.

cs-notify-bot: Customer success ping sent to contacts for affected customers.

alex (oncall): handoff: @mayanext (next oncall) — taking over in 15. I'll update PD notes and close my ack when handed off. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maya (sre): grabbing handoff. Will keep thread updated with RCA next steps.

---
Post-thread quick summary (to be included in incident doc):
- Symptom: p99 latency burst in eu-west (~2.3s) caused automated PD page.
- Immediate mitigations: 25% region-fallback eu-west -> us-west, increased sidecar concurrency, KV warmup, quota request processed.
- Result: p99 reduced to ~850ms within ~5m; nodes coming up to restore capacity.
- Next steps: full RCA (token-length surge + cache thrash interaction), autoscaler and quota playbook, customer follow-up.
